title: The intern solves challenge packs on a local model, and the pilot that checks it can (harness learning, H3 first part)
request: The owner asked to record everything first, then continue the harness-learning plan with the local model (Qwen3.5-4B now, 9B later), allowing 9 GB of swap. H3 needs a solver that repeats for free, so before any lesson is probed the local model must show it can finish the homework at all.
spec: Plan 'improve the harness so it learns', package H3 (first part): the intern on the local tier only, a challenge pack opened as a project from its public part alone, the attempt graded by code; a learning attempt kept whole as training data, an exam attempt (check or sealed) leaving nothing; a pilot on the first learning variants with its gate fixed before the run (the final stage completed on at least four of five).
plan: measure what the local server returns as reasoning with probe_reasoning before choosing it
write the solver: a gateway with every tier local, the person's request from the brief only, the attempt as an acceptance Run for the grader
write the pilot and its CLI command with the gate fixed before the run
test with a scripted intern that states what the key would state, then review, then run the pilot live at no cost

decisions.why: the probe read its reasoning field and its tool calls; mlx_lm.server returns no tool calls for Qwen3.5 (mlx-lm #1293)

decisions.decision: A learning attempt is its own workspace folder with its events and decisions beside its projects
decisions.why: the store then finds one whole attempt, and a trainer can read the moves with the project they changed

decisions.decision: An exam attempt records nothing and its model exchanges keep their shape only
decisions.why: an exam problem must never become training data, or the check and sealed scores stop measuring anything new

decisions.decision: A homework that broke before the model answered makes the run invalid, not a fail
decisions.why: a stopped server or a crash in DCLab's code would otherwise be stored as evidence that the model cannot do the work

decisions.decision: The pilot's result files are named _pilot
decisions.why: a baseline reader filters by split; a pilot named _learning would look like a baseline

change: dclab_rnd/learning/solver.py and pilot.py (new); dclab_rnd/learning/__main__.py (pilot, a first tiny request before the run); dclab_rnd/learning/scoreboard.py (the pilot split in the result name); dclab_rnd/models/probe_reasoning.py (a verdict for reasoning read without a code word); research_notes/open_models_2026-10/servers.md (new: the measured server); tests/test_learning_h3.py (new).

findings.defect: an exam attempt wrote its events and decisions into the workspace's installed log and ledger
findings.scenario: the pilot command installs the workspace log; an attempt on a check variant left a log and a ledger naming the leak column and the row key, though its project lived in a temporary folder
findings.cause: only the project and the session were moved to the temporary folder; every central writer records into the installed log and ledger
findings.fix: a recording block around each attempt: events quiet, no ledger, exchanges shape only for an exam; the previous log, ledger and switch restored after
findings.impact: exam problems would have reached the training sets
alternatives: refuse exam attempts in the solver and grade them only through the scoreboard

findings.defect: an exam attempt's model exchanges would have been kept whole in the workspace's model_exchanges
findings.scenario: the gateway writes every exchange under its usage log's folder with every message when the prompt switch is on, whatever folder the project lives in
findings.cause: the exchange home is the gateway's usage folder, not the attempt's
findings.fix: the prompt switch set off inside an exam attempt and restored after
findings.impact: the whole exam conversation would have been a training example
findings.open: a kept attempt's exchanges still go to the workspace's folder, not the attempt's own

findings.defect: a stopped server was counted as the model failing the homework
findings.scenario: with Ollama stopped every session failed with a connection error; the verdict said the model finished none, and --write stored it as evidence
findings.cause: the gateway's client checks the settings, never whether the server answers; a raised attempt was a fail row
findings.fix: the command sends one tiny request first and stops; a session that failed before any token came back is a broke row, and any broke row makes the run invalid
findings.impact: a false measurement of the model stored as evidence

findings.defect: a kept attempt's decisions were dropped and its events went to another folder
findings.scenario: the command installed a log but no ledger; the events landed in the workspace's log while the projects sat in the attempt's folder
findings.cause: the attempt never installed records of its own
findings.fix: a kept attempt installs its own log and ledger in its folder
findings.impact: training data lost: the decisions of every learning attempt

findings.defect: a pilot with no model passed its gate
findings.scenario: with no client the intern runs the standard plan, which finishes every stage
findings.cause: only the command checked for a missing client
findings.fix: the pilot refuses to run without a client
findings.impact: the rules measured as if they were the model

findings.defect: stored pilot results carried absolute local paths and no fingerprints
findings.scenario: a kept attempt's folder path written into committed evidence; no generator or grader version beside the score
findings.cause: the row kept the solver's return value as it was
findings.fix: paths relative to the workspace; the generator's and grader's fingerprints in the result
findings.impact: a local path in a pushed file; a score not tied to its grader

findings.defect: a model that answered in words and did nothing was first marked as broke
findings.scenario: the lazy scripted model replied with prose and no tool call: a failed session with no step
findings.cause: the first rule for broke looked only at the steps
findings.fix: broke only when no token came back from the model
findings.impact: a model's real failure would have hidden as an invalid run

measurements.name: the reasoning probe on Ollama with the local Qwen
measurements.result: the field read on both replies; the tool call worked; recall of earlier reasoning not shown; the second reply was empty after long thinking
measurements.next: the pilot measures empty replies on real homework

outcome: The intern can now solve a challenge pack on a model on this machine only; a learning attempt is kept whole (project, session, events, decisions, grade) and an exam attempt leaves nothing; the pilot's gate was fixed before the run and a broken server can no longer be stored as the model's failure.
lessons: Moving a project to a temporary folder is not isolation: every central writer records where it is installed.
A measurement must tell a broken instrument from a bad result before it is stored.
Name a new kind of result so no old reader takes it for its own.
risks: a kept attempt's model exchanges go to the workspace's folder, not the attempt's
the small model may think long and answer nothing; the pilot measures it
